items.headline: Average DAM (Southern proxy) MCP: Rs 2574.38/MWh
items.detail: Day-ahead market average clearing price for 2026-05-04 was Rs 2574.38/MWh across 96 15-min blocks (range Rs 300.38-8999.13/MWh).

raw_values.region_note: Karnataka has no standalone day-ahead price; this uses the IEX Southern-region area clearing price as a proxy (see scope-note.md).

items.headline: Peak-hour (18:00-24:00) MCP premium: +68.9% vs daily avg
items.detail: Peak-hour average MCP was Rs 4347.14/MWh vs the day's overall average of Rs 2574.38/MWh, a +68.9% divergence.

raw_values.region_note: Karnataka has no standalone day-ahead price; this uses the IEX Southern-region area clearing price as a proxy (see scope-note.md).

items.headline: Wide intraday MCP spread: 338% of daily average
items.detail: Max-min spread of Rs 8999.13 - Rs 300.38 = 338% of the daily average, indicating high intraday volatility.
